_doc: REPURPOSING candidates: real, mostly non-oncology drugs with a plausible anti-angiogenic / PI3K-AKT-pathway rationale, paired with the verified targets (PIK3CA, KDR). Run through service.generate_candidate_ideas(check_novelty=True): the novelty gate KEEPS only (compound × target × canine hemangiosarcoma) triples with no prior literature, so this surfaces NOVEL repurposing hypotheses (not textbook inhibitors) that are immediately dockable against the verified pocket. evidence_refs are curation placeholders. Docking will refute most (these aren't kinase inhibitors) and the orthogonal cofolding lane catches docking false positives (see fenofibrate) — that's the point: keep the survivors, file the refutations. Grow this list to keep the autonomous loop fed; add targets to data/target_library.json to widen what's dockable.
